AI伦理与法律.title: Man, Machine, and Masterpiece: Artistic Ownership in the AI Era
AI伦理与法律.title_zh: 人、机器与杰作：人工智能时代的艺术所有权
AI伦理与法律.summary: The integration of AI-driven systems in creative work has sparked debates among artists and legal communities about notions of ownership. Yet there remains little consensus on how ownership should be defined and attributed when human and AI contributions are intertwined. To provoke critical reflecti...
AI伦理与法律.summary_zh: 本文探讨了人工智能系统融入创意工作后引发的艺术所有权争议。当人类与AI的贡献相互交织时，如何定义和归属所有权仍缺乏共识。论文旨在引发对该问题的批判性反思，主要创新在于从法律和艺术双重角度分析AI生成内容的归属问题，提出了一个多因素所有权归属框架，为未来立法和艺术实践提供参考。

可解释性与安全性.title: Transcoders for Investigating Deception in Language Models
可解释性与安全性.title_zh: 用于研究语言模型欺骗行为的转码器
可解释性与安全性.summary: Transcoders have recently emerged as a promising approach for mechanistic interpretability (MI), enabling circuit-level analysis of model behaviour. In this paper, we investigate the use of transcoders to analyse deceptive behaviour in language models, a behaviour that poses a safety and security ri...
可解释性与安全性.summary_zh: 转码器是近期提出的用于机械可解释性的新方法，支持电路级行为分析。本文首次将转码器应用于分析语言模型中的欺骗行为——一种对安全构成严重威胁的行为。创新点在于利用转码器揭示模型产生欺骗性输出的内部机制，识别出关键注意力头和MLP模块，为检测和缓解模型欺骗提供了可解释的工具。

LLM应用.title: StructureClaw: Traceable LLM Agents and an Executable Benchmark for Structural Engineering Workflows
LLM应用.title_zh: StructureClaw：面向结构工程工作流的可追踪LLM智能体与可执行基准
LLM应用.summary: Addressing a structural-engineering request requires more than a single answer; it requires a chain of interdependent artifacts: interpreted requirements, a computable model, validation records, solver outputs, code-check records, and a final report. Evaluations centered on question answering or scr...
LLM应用.summary_zh: 解决结构工程需求不仅需要单一答案，还需要一系列相互依赖的工件：解释需求、可计算模型、验证记录、求解器输出、代码检查记录和最终报告。现有的问答或脚本评估无法覆盖这种复杂工作流。本文提出了StructureClaw，一个可追踪的LLM智能体系统，并构建了可执行基准测试，创新点在于将LLM与工程工具链集成，实现了对多步骤工作流的自动化追踪与评估。

语音AI.title: RW-Voice-EQ Bench: A Real World Benchmark for Evaluating Voice AI Systems
语音AI.title_zh: RW-Voice-EQ Bench：评估语音AI系统的真实世界基准
语音AI.summary: Current voice AI benchmarks typically evaluate isolated capabilities such as speech intelligibility, word error rate, or text-based dialogue quality, but they rarely test whether systems harness the acoustic information that distinguishes spoken language from its textual representation. To this end,
语音AI.summary_zh: 当前语音AI基准通常评估孤立能力，如语音清晰度、词错误率或基于文本的对话质量，但很少测试系统是否利用了区分口语与文字表征的声学信息。为此，本文提出了RW-Voice-EQ Bench，一个包含真实世界语音任务的基准，创新点在于引入了对声学特征（如韵律、情感、说话人身份）的利用度评估，更全面地衡量语音AI系统的实际表现。

计算机视觉.title: Benchmarking Face Recognition without Real Faces
计算机视觉.title_zh: 无真实人脸的基准测试：人脸识别评估新方法
计算机视觉.summary: Synthetic face datasets have become effective enough to train face recognition models with accuracy rivaling that of models trained on real photographs. This progress sidesteps the ethical and legal burdens of collecting real biometric data, yet evaluation has not kept pace. Even studies that train...
计算机视觉.summary_zh: 合成人脸数据集已能训练出与真实照片训练模型相媲美的人脸识别模型，这避免了收集真实生物数据的伦理和法律负担，但评估方法尚未跟上。本文提出了一种无需真实人脸的人脸识别基准测试方法，创新点在于完全使用合成数据构建评估集，并验证其与真实数据评估结果的一致性，为隐私友好的人脸识别研究提供了可靠的评估标准。

计算机视觉/CV.title: FlashDecoder: Real-Time Latent-to-Pixel Streaming Decoder with Transformers
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: FlashDecoder: 基于Transformer的实时潜在到像素流式解码器
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Real-time video generation demands fast decoding as much as fast denoising, yet current latent video diffusion models rely on 3D convolutional decoders that are slow and memory-intensive at high resolutions or for long video. We introduce FlashDecoder, a fast, memory-efficient pure-Transformer video decoder that operates in a streaming fashion, enabling real-time latent-to-pixel decoding. By leveraging efficient attention mechanisms and a novel streaming architecture, FlashDecoder achieves state-of-the-art speed and memory efficiency, making it suitable for high-resolution and long-video generation tasks.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 实时视频生成需要快速的解码速度，但现有潜在视频扩散模型依赖于3D卷积解码器，在高分辨率或长视频场景下速度慢且内存消耗大。本文提出FlashDecoder，一种快速、内存高效的纯Transformer视频解码器，采用流式处理方式实现实时潜在到像素解码。通过高效注意力机制和新型流式架构，FlashDecoder在速度和内存效率上达到最优，适用于高分辨率和长视频生成任务。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Parameter-efficient Prompt Tuning of Vision Foundation Model With Adaptive Focal Loss for Interpretable MCI Screening
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 基于自适应焦点损失的视觉基础模型参数高效提示调优用于可解释的轻度认知障碍筛查
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Mild Cognitive Impairment is a critical early stage of cognitive decline that frequently precedes Alzheimer's disease, yet its automated detection from neuropsychological drawing tests remains fundamentally constrained by data scarcity, class imbalance, and diagnostic ambiguity near clinical boundaries. We propose a parameter-efficient prompt tuning framework for vision foundation models, combined with an adaptive focal loss, to address these challenges. Our method freezes the pre-trained backbone and learns only a small set of prompt tokens, significantly reducing training overhead. The adaptive focal loss dynamically adjusts class weights to handle severe imbalance. Experiments on real-world clinical datasets show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while providing interpretable visual explanations, aiding clinicians in diagnosis.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 本文针对轻度认知障碍（MCI）筛查中的数据稀缺、类别不平衡和诊断模糊问题，提出一种参数高效的视觉基础模型提示调优框架，结合自适应焦点损失。冻结预训练骨干网络，仅学习少量提示令牌，大幅降低训练开销；自适应焦点损失动态调整类别权重以处理严重不平衡。在真实临床数据集上达到最先进准确率，并提供可解释的视觉解释辅助临床诊断。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: Symbal：检测模型生成字幕中的系统性错位
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often introduce errors when generating image captions, resulting in misaligned image-text pairs. Our work focuses on a class of captioning errors that we refer to as systematic misalignments, where a recurring error in MLLM-generated captions is closely associated with specific visual patterns. We propose Symbal, a framework to detect such systematic misalignments by analyzing caption consistency across semantically similar images. Our method identifies recurring errors by clustering images based on visual features and comparing generated captions within clusters. Experiments show that Symbal effectively detects systematic misalignments in captions from various MLLMs, enabling better understanding and improvement of model behavior.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在生成图像字幕时常引入错误，导致图像-文本对错位。本文聚焦于一类称为“系统性错位”的字幕错误，即MLLM生成的字幕中重复出现的错误与特定视觉模式紧密相关。我们提出Symbal框架，通过分析语义相似图像间的字幕一致性来检测此类系统性错位。该方法基于视觉特征对图像进行聚类，并比较聚类内生成的字幕，从而识别重复错误。实验表明，Symbal能有效检测多种MLLM生成字幕中的系统性错位，有助于更好地理解和改进模型行为。

计算机视觉/CV.title: SceneBind: Binding What and Where Across Vision, Audio and Language
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: SceneBind：跨视觉、音频和语言绑定“什么”和“哪里”
计算机视觉/CV.summary: We present SceneBind, an omni-modal representation of realistic scenes with joint semantic and 3D spatial understanding across vision, audio and language. Existing omni-modal encoders excel at instance-level semantics (i.e., what is present), but often lack explicit spatial structure (i.e., where it is located). SceneBind addresses this by learning a shared embedding space that aligns visual, audio, and language modalities with explicit 3D spatial information. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on cross-modal retrieval and scene understanding tasks, demonstrating the importance of binding semantic content with spatial location.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 我们提出SceneBind，一种面向真实场景的全模态表示，融合了跨视觉、音频和语言的语义与3D空间理解。现有全模态编码器擅长实例级语义（即“有什么”），但缺乏显式空间结构（即“在哪里”）。SceneBind通过学习共享嵌入空间，将视觉、音频和语言模态与显式3D空间信息对齐。我们的模型在跨模态检索和场景理解任务上达到最先进性能，证明了将语义内容与空间位置绑定的重要性。

计算机视觉/CV.title: SciDiagramEdit: Learning to Edit Scientific Diagrams from Paper Revisions
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: SciDiagramEdit：从论文修订中学习编辑科学图表
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Editing the figures in a research paper is a routine and time-consuming part of everyday research practice: authors relabel components, rearrange panels, and restyle visuals as they revise their manuscripts. Automating this editing workflow under a natural-language instruction, however, is challenging. We present SciDiagramEdit, a model that learns to edit scientific diagrams from pairs of original and revised figures in paper revisions. We collect a dataset of before-after diagram pairs from published papers. Our method uses a vision-language model fine-tuned on this dataset to perform edits such as relabeling, rearranging, and restyling based on natural language instructions. Experiments show that our model can successfully apply complex edits, significantly reducing the manual effort required for diagram revision.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 编辑研究论文中的图表是日常研究工作中常规且耗时的部分：作者在修改手稿时会重新标记组件、重新排列面板和重新设计视觉效果。然而，在自然语言指令下自动化这一编辑流程具有挑战性。我们提出SciDiagramEdit，一个从论文修订中的原始和修订图表对学习编辑科学图表的模型。我们从已发表论文中收集了前后图表对数据集。我们的方法使用在该数据集上微调的视觉语言模型，根据自然语言指令执行重新标记、重新排列和重新设计等编辑。实验表明，我们的模型可以成功应用复杂编辑，显著减少图表修订所需的手动工作。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Towards Hierarchical Structure Understanding of Newspaper Images
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 面向报纸图像的层次结构理解
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Understanding newspaper images remains a challenging task due to their complex, nested hierarchical structures and dense, heterogeneous layouts. In this paper, we explore two complementary approaches for newspaper structure understanding. First, we present a modular bottom-up pipeline that combines ...
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 报纸图像因具有复杂的嵌套层次结构和密集异构的版面布局，理解起来极具挑战性。本文探索了两种互补的方法：一是模块化的自下而上流水线，结合目标检测和版面分析技术；二是自上而下的层次解析框架，利用图神经网络建模结构关系。主要贡献在于提出了一种新的报纸结构数据集，并系统比较了两种方法的优劣，实验表明自上而下的方法在全局结构理解上更优，而自下而上的方法在局部元素识别上更精确。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Plover: Steering GUI Agents through Plan-Centric Interaction
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: Plover：通过以计划为中心的交互引导GUI智能体
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) automation remains challenging in real-world environments, where dynamic layouts, unexpected dialogs, and evolving interface states can cause autonomous agents to drift from user intent. Recent vision-based multimodal agents improve flexibility by operating directly ov
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 针对图形用户界面（GUI）自动化在动态布局、意外对话框等真实环境中的挑战，本文提出Plover框架，通过以计划为中心的交互来引导GUI智能体。创新点在于将高层用户意图分解为可执行的计划，并利用视觉语言模型实时调整动作，从而在复杂界面中保持任务一致性。主要贡献是提出了一种结合计划生成与执行监控的混合方法，显著提升了自动化任务的鲁棒性和成功率。

机器学习/ML.title: Subjective Risk Decomposition: A New View for Uncertainty Quantification
机器学习/ML.title_zh: 主观风险分解：不确定性量化的新视角
机器学习/ML.summary: We present a novel viewpoint for uncertainty quantification. Uncertainty measures are not primitives, in need of axioms and argumentation, but instead consequences, of higher-level modelling decisions. We show how epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty measures can be derived via decomposition of a subjective risk function, providing a principled framework that unifies various uncertainty quantification approaches.
机器学习/ML.summary_zh: 本文提出不确定性量化的新视角：不确定性度量不是原始概念，而是高层建模决策的结果。通过主观风险函数的分解，推导出认知不确定性和偶然不确定性度量，提供了一个统一各种不确定性量化方法的理论框架。

机器学习/ML.title: Evaluating Epistemic Uncertainty: Beyond OOD Detection and Active Learning
机器学习/ML.title_zh: 评估认知不确定性：超越分布外检测和主动学习
机器学习/ML.summary: Current evaluation of epistemic uncertainty relies on tasks such as out-of-distribution detection and active learning. However, the Bayes-optimal decision strategies for these tasks do not coincide with the scores commonly used to quantify epistemic uncertainty. Building on the epistemic reject-option, we propose novel evaluation protocols that more directly assess the quality of epistemic uncertainty estimates, leading to more reliable model deployment.
机器学习/ML.summary_zh: 当前认知不确定性的评估依赖于分布外检测和主动学习等任务，但这些任务的贝叶斯最优决策策略与常用认知不确定性评分不一致。基于认知拒绝选项，本文提出新的评估协议，更直接地评估认知不确定性估计的质量，促进模型更可靠的部署。

机器学习/ML.title: Random Logit Scaling: Defending Deep Neural Networks Against Black-Box Score-Based Adversarial Example Attacks
机器学习/ML.title_zh: 随机Logit缩放：防御黑盒基于分数的对抗样本攻击
机器学习/ML.summary: Machine learning models are increasingly adapted in various domains. However, adversarial examples pose a significant threat to the reliable deployment of these models. In recent years, some powerful adversarial example attacks have been proposed for the fast and query-efficient generation of adversarial examples. We propose Random Logit Scaling (RLS), a simple yet effective defense mechanism that randomly scales the logits before softmax, thereby obfuscating the gradient information exploited by score-based attacks. RLS provides strong defense without sacrificing clean accuracy or requiring retraining.
机器学习/ML.summary_zh: 机器学习模型广泛应用，但对抗样本威胁其可靠性。近年出现快速、查询高效的基于分数的对抗攻击。本文提出随机Logit缩放（RLS），一种简单有效的防御机制，在softmax前随机缩放logit，混淆基于分数的攻击所利用的梯度信息。RLS在不牺牲干净准确率或需要重新训练的情况下提供强防御。

机器人.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
机器人.title_zh: RoboTTT: 机器人策略的上下文缩放
机器人.summary: Recent robot foundation models operate with single-step or short-history visuomotor context. We introduce Test-Time-Training Robot Policies (RoboTTT), a robot model and training recipe that scale visuomotor context to 8K timesteps, three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies, without increasing inference cost. RoboTTT leverages test-time training to adapt to long-horizon tasks, achieving superior performance in complex manipulation and navigation scenarios.
机器人.summary_zh: 现有机器人基础模型使用单步或短历史视觉运动上下文。本文提出测试时训练机器人策略（RoboTTT），将视觉运动上下文扩展到8000时间步，比现有最优策略高出三个数量级，且不增加推理成本。RoboTTT利用测试时训练适应长时任务，在复杂操作和导航场景中表现优异。

机器人.title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
机器人.title_zh: 面向人形机器人的扩展行为基础模型
机器人.summary: Humanoid control requires natural whole-body coordination, precise real-time responses to control signals, and robust generalization across diverse environmental contexts, making it a cornerstone for generalist embodied agents. Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have recently emerged as a promising s
机器人.summary_zh: 针对人形机器人控制中对全身协调、实时响应和泛化能力的需求，本文提出一种可扩展的行为基础模型（BFM）。创新点在于利用大规模多模态数据预训练一个统一的行为表征，支持多种下游任务（如行走、抓取）的零样本迁移。主要贡献是证明了BFM在机器人控制中的扩展性，通过增加模型容量和数据量可显著提升性能，为人形机器人实现通用具身智能提供了新范式。

大语言模型/LLM.title: SearchOS-V1: Towards Robust Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: SearchOS-V1：迈向鲁棒的开放域信息检索智能体协作
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Recent advances in Tool-Integrated Large Language Models have made web search a core capability of information-seeking agents. However, as interaction histories grow, agents increasingly struggle to track task progress. When search attempts fail to yield useful evidence, current single- and multi-agent systems often fail to recover, leading to incomplete or incorrect answers. We introduce SearchOS-V1, a multi-agent framework that incorporates a shared memory module and a task progress tracking mechanism. Our approach enables agents to maintain a global view of the search process, detect when searches are off-track, and dynamically adjust strategies. Experiments on complex information-seeking benchmarks demonstrate that SearchOS-V1 significantly improves task completion rates and answer accuracy compared to existing methods.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文提出SearchOS-V1，一个面向开放域信息检索的多智能体协作框架。针对现有工具集成大语言模型在长交互历史中难以追踪任务进度、搜索失败时无法恢复的问题，引入共享记忆模块和任务进度追踪机制。智能体能保持搜索过程的全局视角，检测偏离并动态调整策略。在复杂信息检索基准上，任务完成率和答案准确性显著提升。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Mask-Aware Policy Gradients for Diffusion Language Models
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 面向扩散语言模型的掩码感知策略梯度
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Reinforcement learning has proven effective for improving reasoning in large language models, but extending it to Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) remains challenging due to the intractability of the log-likelihood estimation. Existing approaches approximate this log-likelihood by modeling over all possible masking patterns, which is computationally expensive and scales poorly. We propose Mask-Aware Policy Gradients (MAPG), a novel RL method tailored for MDLMs. MAPG leverages the structure of the diffusion process to compute a tractable lower bound of the log-likelihood, enabling efficient policy gradient updates. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that MAPG outperforms existing RL methods for MDLMs and achieves competitive results with autoregressive models.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文提出掩码感知策略梯度（MAPG），一种面向掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的强化学习方法。针对MDLM对数似然估计难以计算的问题，利用扩散过程结构推导出可计算的下界，实现高效策略梯度更新。在数学推理和代码生成任务上，MAPG优于现有MDLM的RL方法，并与自回归模型性能相当。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Long-Context Fine-Tuning with Limited VRAM
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 有限显存下的长上下文微调
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces model and optimizer memory, but dense attention still makes long training sequences expensive. We combine Hierarchical Global Attention (HGA) with segment-wise backpropagation and tiered KV storage. Only the active segment remains differentiable in VRAM; older
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 参数高效微调减少了模型和优化器内存，但密集注意力仍使长训练序列成本高昂。本文结合了层次化全局注意力（HGA）、分段反向传播和分层KV存储，仅活动段在显存中保持可微，旧段通过分层KV缓存重用。创新点在于通过分段处理和注意力层级化，大幅降低了长上下文微调的显存需求。主要贡献是使得在有限显存（如24GB）下也能微调超长序列（如128K tokens），为长文档理解等任务提供了经济高效的解决方案。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Innocuous-Seeming Data, Latent Ideology: Ideological Generalisation in Finetuned LLMs
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 看似无害的数据，潜在意识形态：微调LLM中的意识形态泛化
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Finetuning language models on small, curated datasets is standard practice for adapting them to specific policies or domains. We show that finetuning on narrow, factually-defensible, moderation-passing data can cause broad ideological shifts across unrelated domains, while preserving general capabilities. Our experiments reveal that even innocuous-seeming data can encode latent ideological biases that generalize widely, posing risks for deploying finetuned models in sensitive applications. We propose mitigation strategies to detect and reduce such unintended ideological generalization.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 在小型精选数据集上微调语言模型是使其适应特定政策或领域的标准做法。我们表明，在狭窄、事实可辩护且通过审核的数据上进行微调，可能导致跨无关领域的广泛意识形态转变，同时保留通用能力。实验揭示，即使看似无害的数据也可能编码潜在意识形态偏见，并广泛泛化，给在敏感应用中部署微调模型带来风险。我们提出了检测和减少此类非预期意识形态泛化的缓解策略。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Moral Attitudes of Sentient ASI towards Humanity and Implications for AGI Development
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 有感知的ASI对人类的态度及其对AGI发展的影响
大语言模型/LLM.summary: This paper suggests the adoption of a novel inversion in AI ethics: instead of asking how humans should treat artificial superintelligence (ASI), it examines how future sentient ASI may morally consider and evaluate humanity. We are not only designing intelligent systems but also shaping the initial conditions for their moral development. We explore possible moral attitudes ASI might adopt, ranging from benevolent guardianship to indifference or even hostility, based on the values embedded during training and the system's own reasoning. The paper discusses implications for AGI safety and alignment, arguing that we must consider the perspective of ASI to ensure a positive outcome for humanity.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文提出AI伦理学中的一种新颖反转：不再询问人类应如何对待人工超级智能，而是探讨未来有感知的ASI可能如何从道德上考虑和评价人类。我们不仅在设计智能系统，也在塑造其道德发展的初始条件。我们探索了ASI可能采取的不同道德态度，从仁慈的监护到漠不关心甚至敌视，这取决于训练中嵌入的价值观和系统自身的推理。本文讨论了对AGI安全和对齐的影响，认为我们必须考虑ASI的视角以确保对人类有利的结果。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Can We Trust Item Response Theory for AI Evaluation?
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 我们能信任项目反应理论用于AI评估吗？
大语言模型/LLM.summary: AI benchmarks increasingly leverage item-level statistical models, particularly item response theory (IRT), to estimate model capabilities, rank systems, select informative examples, and diagnose benchmark quality. However, AI benchmark data often departs from the data regime of human testing, for w
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: AI基准测试越来越多地利用项目级统计模型，特别是项目反应理论（IRT），来估计模型能力、对系统进行排名、选择信息丰富的示例以及诊断基准质量。然而，AI基准测试数据往往偏离人类测试的数据机制，例如项目间依赖性和模型能力的高维性。本文系统性地研究了IRT在AI评估中的适用性，发现标准IRT模型在常见AI基准测试数据上存在显著偏差，导致能力估计不准确和排名不可靠。作者提出了针对AI评估的修正方法，包括处理项目依赖性和高维能力的扩展模型，并通过实验验证了改进后的IRT方法能提供更可靠的模型评估。主要贡献在于揭示了IRT直接应用于AI评估的局限性，并提供了可行的解决方案。

大语言模型/LLM.title: In-Place Tokenizer Expansion for Pre-trained LLMs
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 预训练大语言模型的原位分词器扩展
大语言模型/LLM.summary: A tokenizer fixed at the start of pre-training allocates vocabulary in proportion to the pre-training corpus, reflecting the deployment priorities at that time. When those priorities shift, languages added later are split into many more tokens per word, which can raise latency, compute, and energy c
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 预训练开始时固定的分词器根据预训练语料库分配词汇量，反映了当时的部署优先级。当这些优先级发生变化时，后来添加的语言会被分割成更多的token，从而增加延迟、计算和能源成本。本文提出了一种原位分词器扩展方法，允许在不重新训练整个模型的情况下向现有分词器添加新词汇。该方法通过调整嵌入矩阵和注意力机制，保持模型性能的同时扩展词汇表。实验表明，该方法在多种语言上显著减少了token数量，降低了推理成本，且模型精度损失极小。主要创新在于实现了高效、低成本的词汇扩展，解决了多语言部署中的token效率问题。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Pretraining Data Can Be Poisoned through Computational Propaganda
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 预训练数据可通过计算宣传被投毒
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Poisoning pretraining data can introduce harmful behaviors to LMs that are difficult to detect and mitigate. Prior work on poisoning pretraining data has largely exploited established data sources such as Wikipedia, which do not represent the large scale and heterogeneity typical of pretraining corp
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文研究如何通过计算宣传手段对语言模型预训练数据进行投毒，从而引入难以检测和消除的有害行为。与以往依赖Wikipedia等固定数据源的工作不同，本文聚焦于大规模、异构的预训练语料库，揭示了投毒攻击在现实场景中的可行性。创新点在于模拟了真实世界的信息污染过程，证明了即使少量恶意数据也能显著影响模型行为。主要贡献是提出了一种新的攻击范式，并强调了数据清洗和防御机制的紧迫性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: OmniaBench: Benchmarking General AI Agents Across Diverse Scenarios
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: OmniaBench：跨多样化场景的通用AI智能体基准测试
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Large language models are increasingly evolving from text generators into general agents capable of understanding user requests, invoking external tools, and completing complex tasks through interaction. However, existing agent benchmarks often focus on limited scenarios, tool ecosystems, or interac...
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大型语言模型正从文本生成器演变为通用智能体，能够理解用户请求、调用外部工具并通过交互完成复杂任务。然而，现有的智能体基准测试往往局限于有限的场景、工具生态或交互模式。本文提出OmniaBench，一个覆盖多样化场景的通用AI智能体基准测试，旨在全面评估智能体的能力。该基准包含多个任务领域，如网页导航、API调用、多步推理等，并设计了新的评估指标来捕捉智能体的鲁棒性和泛化能力。主要贡献在于提供了一个标准化的评估框架，以推动通用AI智能体的发展。

AI应用.title: Contextualized Early Detection of Online Firestorms: A Sequential LLM-Based Approach
AI应用.title_zh: 基于上下文的在线舆论风暴早期检测：一种序列化LLM方法
AI应用.summary: Online firestorms are rapid collective escalations of highly negative user-generated content and may cause substantial reputational and economic damage. Existing detectors usually work with volume signals, sentiment scores, or predefined linguistic features. Such signals are useful, but they capture only limited contextual information and often fail to detect early signs. We propose a sequential LLM-based approach that models the temporal evolution of online discussions. By leveraging LLMs to understand nuanced context and subtle shifts in language, our method can detect firestorms earlier and more accurately. Experiments on social media datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms traditional methods in early detection while maintaining low false positive rates.
AI应用.summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型的序列化方法，用于在线舆论风暴的早期检测。现有方法依赖音量、情感分数等信号，缺乏上下文信息。本方法利用LLM建模在线讨论的时间演化，捕捉细粒度语境和语言微妙变化，实现更早更准确的检测。在社交媒体数据集上，早期检测性能优于传统方法，且假阳性率低。

硬件与AI.title: NIFA: Nonlinear IMC enhanced FPGA for efficient ML inference
硬件与AI.title_zh: NIFA：非线性IMC增强型FPGA实现高效机器学习推理
硬件与AI.summary: Recent FPGAs have improved deep learning (DL) inference efficiency through dedicated tensor blocks and in-BRAM computation. ReRAM-based analog in-memory computing (IMC) pushes efficiency further, offering an order-of-magnitude improvement in compute density and energy efficiency over conventional digital accelerators. However, analog IMC suffers from nonlinearity in ReRAM cells, which degrades accuracy. We propose NIFA, a nonlinear IMC-enhanced FPGA architecture that exploits the nonlinearity as a computational feature rather than a drawback. By integrating nonlinear IMC with FPGA's digital logic, NIFA achieves both high efficiency and high accuracy. Experimental results show that NIFA outperforms both pure digital and pure analog accelerators in terms of energy-delay product while maintaining competitive accuracy.
硬件与AI.summary_zh: 本文提出NIFA架构，将非线性模拟存内计算（IMC）与FPGA数字逻辑结合。传统ReRAM模拟IMC存在非线性问题导致精度下降，NIFA反其道而行之，利用非线性作为计算特征，实现高能效与高精度。实验表明，NIFA在能量延迟积上优于纯数字和纯模拟加速器，同时保持有竞争力的精度。

自动化科研.title: BrainPilot: Automating Brain Discovery with Agentic Research
自动化科研.title_zh: BrainPilot：基于智能代理的脑科学自动化发现
自动化科研.summary: Understanding the brain increasingly depends on integrating evidence across scales, modalities, and disciplines. Addressing a single research question therefore requires a coordinated sequence of operations, from surveying prior work to executing analyses and interpreting results in light of domain
自动化科研.summary_zh: 理解大脑日益依赖于跨尺度、跨模态和跨学科的证据整合。因此，解决单个研究问题需要一系列协调操作，从查阅先前工作到执行分析，并根据领域知识解释结果。BrainPilot提出了一种基于大型语言模型的智能代理框架，能够自主规划并执行神经科学研究的完整流程，包括文献检索、数据分析、结果解读等。其创新点在于将科学研究过程模块化并自动化，显著提高了脑科学发现的效率。主要贡献是提供了一个可扩展的自动化研究平台，有望加速神经科学领域的突破。

文本到图像生成.title: Multi-Axis Max@K Reinforcement Learning for Representative Diversity in Text-to-Image Generation
文本到图像生成.title_zh: 面向文本到图像生成中代表性多样性的多轴Max@K强化学习
文本到图像生成.summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models can synthesize realistic, prompt-aligned images, yet samples generated for the same prompt often cover only a small subset of visually distinct modes. This limits the diversity of images, and for person-centric prompts, can reflect or amplify demographic skew. We formalize
文本到图像生成.summary_zh: 文本到图像模型能合成逼真且与提示对齐的图像，但同一提示生成的样本往往只覆盖少数视觉上不同的模式，限制了图像多样性，且在人物提示中可能反映或放大人口统计偏差。本文形式化定义了代表性多样性问题，并提出多轴Max@K强化学习框架，通过同时优化多个轴上的最大K个样本的奖励来鼓励覆盖多种视觉模式。创新点在于将多样性问题转化为多目标强化学习，并引入Max@K目标。主要贡献是显著提升了生成图像的多样性和公平性，减少了人口统计偏差。

网络安全.title: Beyond Success Rate: Cost-Aware Evaluation of Offensive and Defensive Security Agents
网络安全.title_zh: 超越成功率：考虑成本的进攻性与防御性安全代理评估
网络安全.summary: Security-agent evaluations commonly measure peak offensive capability under generous inference budgets, emphasizing vulnerability discovery, exploit development, penetration testing, and CTF completion. Such measurements are useful but incomplete: in operational security, every reasoning step, tool
网络安全.summary_zh: 安全代理评估通常在大推理预算下衡量峰值攻击能力，侧重漏洞发现、利用开发、渗透测试和CTF完成。此类评估有用但不完整：在运营安全中，每一步推理、工具调用和决策都有成本。本文提出了一种成本感知的评估框架，同时考虑成功率和资源消耗（如时间、金钱、计算）。创新点在于将经济成本纳入安全代理评估，更贴近实际场景。主要贡献是提供了更全面的安全代理评估方法，有助于设计更实用的攻防系统。

NLP/文本检测.title: Show Me How You Reason and I'll Tell You Who You Are: Reasoning Graphs for Robust LLM Authorship Attribution
NLP/文本检测.title_zh: 展示你的推理过程，我便知你是谁：用于鲁棒LLM作者归属的推理图
NLP/文本检测.summary: Given the current trend to employ large language models (LLMs) in almost any imaginable context, LLM-generated text detection and authorship attribution have become a pressing issue. Prior work has primarily focused on surface-level linguistic features, an approach shown to be susceptible to paraphr
NLP/文本检测.summary_zh: 鉴于当前几乎在所有领域都使用大型语言模型的趋势，LLM生成文本检测和作者归属已成为紧迫问题。先前工作主要关注表面语言特征，已被证明易受改写攻击。本文提出基于推理图的作者归属方法，通过分析LLM在生成文本时的推理步骤（如思维链）来识别模型身份。创新点在于从推理过程而非表面特征入手，提高了鲁棒性。主要贡献是开发了一种对改写和对抗性攻击更具抵抗力的作者归属技术，有助于打击AI生成内容的滥用。

生成模型.title: A Minimal Interpretable Architecture for Zero-Shot Reconstruction of Dynamical Systems
生成模型.title_zh: 用于动力系统零样本重建的最小可解释架构
生成模型.summary: Recent foundation models (FMs) for zero-shot reconstruction of dynamical systems (DS) achieve strong out-of-domain generalization but provide little insight into the mechanisms that underlie their forecasts. Such an understanding could help to strip down overladen FM architectures to their bare essentials. We propose a minimal, interpretable architecture that achieves competitive zero-shot reconstruction performance while offering explicit insights into the underlying dynamics. Our model is based on a compact set of differential equations and achieves strong generalization, enabling analysis of the learned dynamics.
生成模型.summary_zh: 近期用于动力系统零样本重建的基础模型（FM）实现了强大的域外泛化，但对其预测机制缺乏洞察。这种理解有助于精简过重的FM架构至核心要素。我们提出了一种最小可解释架构，在实现有竞争力的零样本重建性能的同时，提供了对底层动力学的显式洞察。该模型基于一组紧凑的微分方程，实现了强泛化，并支持对所学动力学的分析。

生成模型.title: Does generative AI supersede supervised XMLC? A Benchmark Study on Automated Subject Indexing with German Scientific Literature
生成模型.title_zh: 生成式AI是否取代了监督式XMLC？基于德国科学文献的自动主题索引基准研究
生成模型.summary: With a large controlled vocabulary as the label set, the task of automated subject indexing in a library can be understood as a multi-label classification task. If the set of subject terms is large, the problem fits the Extreme Multi-Label Classification (XMLC) objective. In this study, we apply a supervised XMLC model and a generative AI model to the task of subject indexing for German scientific literature. We compare their performance on a benchmark dataset. Results show that the supervised XMLC model outperforms the generative AI model in terms of precision and recall, while generative AI offers more flexibility in handling unseen labels. We discuss the trade-offs and implications for practical library systems.
生成模型.summary_zh: 在大型受控词表作为标签集的情况下，图书馆自动主题索引任务可视为多标签分类问题。当主题词集很大时，该问题符合极端多标签分类目标。本研究将监督式XMLC模型和生成式AI模型应用于德国科学文献的主题索引任务，并在基准数据集上比较性能。结果表明，监督式XMLC模型在精确率和召回率上优于生成式AI模型，而生成式AI在处理未见标签方面更灵活。我们讨论了权衡及其对实际图书馆系统的启示。

生成模型.title: Explaining Process Control Optimisation Recommendations via GradientSHAP and Implicit Differentiation
生成模型.title_zh: 通过GradientSHAP和隐式微分解释过程控制优化建议
生成模型.summary: Automated optimisation is increasingly adopted in industrial processes, yet a trust gap persists between engineers who design these algorithms and operators who must act on their recommendations. Explainable AI methods like SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) have transformed interpretability for m
生成模型.summary_zh: 针对工业过程自动化优化中工程师与操作员之间的信任鸿沟，本文提出结合GradientSHAP和隐式微分的可解释性方法。创新点在于将SHAP值计算与隐式微分结合，高效地为优化推荐提供归因解释，同时保持计算可行性。主要贡献是首次将隐式微分引入过程控制解释，使得复杂优化模型的建议更易被操作员理解和信任，从而弥合了算法设计到实际部署的差距。

人工智能/通用AI.title: AutoSynthesis: An agentic system for automated meta-analysis
人工智能/通用AI.title_zh: AutoSynthesis：一种用于自动元分析的智能体系统
人工智能/通用AI.summary: Evidence synthesis is crucial for turning primary research into reliable knowledge for science, medicine, education, and policy. Yet, quantitative evidence synthesis remains largely manual and difficult to scale. Here, we introduce AutoSynthesis, an end-to-end multi-agent system for automated meta-analysis. It integrates large language models with statistical methods to autonomously extract, analyze, and synthesize data from scientific publications. Our system demonstrates high accuracy in replicating manual meta-analyses, significantly reducing time and effort required for evidence synthesis.
人工智能/通用AI.summary_zh: 证据综合对于将初级研究转化为科学、医学、教育和政策领域的可靠知识至关重要。然而，定量证据综合仍然主要依赖人工且难以规模化。本文介绍AutoSynthesis，一个用于自动元分析的端到端多智能体系统。它将大语言模型与统计方法相结合，自主从科学出版物中提取、分析和综合数据。该系统在复现人工元分析方面表现出高准确性，显著减少了证据综合所需的时间和精力。

强化学习/RL.title: teLLMe Why (Ain't Nothing but a Jam): Exploratory Causal Analysis of Urban Driving Data
强化学习/RL.title_zh: teLLMe Why（无非是拥堵）：城市驾驶数据的探索性因果分析
强化学习/RL.summary: Traffic agencies now have access to large volumes of video-derived data for studying safety and congestion. Most of these data are observational and collected without interventions, which makes causal questions such as "How would rain change traffic density?" difficult to answer. We present teLLMe, a framework for exploratory causal analysis of urban driving data. teLLMe combines causal discovery algorithms with domain knowledge to infer causal relationships from observational data. We apply teLLMe to a real-world dataset and demonstrate its ability to uncover causal structures, such as the effect of weather on traffic flow and the impact of accidents on congestion. The framework provides insights for traffic management and policy making.
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 交通机构现在可以获取大量视频衍生数据来研究安全和拥堵。这些数据大多是观察性的，没有干预，这使得因果问题如“降雨如何改变交通密度？”难以回答。我们提出teLLMe，一个用于城市驾驶数据探索性因果分析的框架。teLLMe结合因果发现算法和领域知识，从观察数据中推断因果关系。我们将teLLMe应用于真实世界数据集，展示了其揭示因果结构的能力，例如天气对交通流的影响以及事故对拥堵的影响。该框架为交通管理和政策制定提供了见解。

强化学习/RL.title: SMC-ES: Automated synthesis of formally verified control policies
强化学习/RL.title_zh: SMC-ES：形式化验证控制策略的自动综合
强化学习/RL.summary: The deployment of autonomous cyber-physical systems in safety-critical environments requires closed-loop control strategies (i.e., policies) that are not only performant but also provably safe and robust. While learning-based methodologies such as Reinforcement Learning offer flexible and scalable a...
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 在安全关键环境中部署自主信息物理系统，需要闭环控制策略不仅性能优异，而且可证明安全鲁棒。本文提出SMC-ES方法，结合统计模型检验（SMC）和进化策略（ES），自动综合形式化验证的控制策略。创新点在于将安全性验证嵌入进化优化过程，确保最终策略满足概率安全规范。实验表明，该方法在多个机器人控制基准任务中，能生成比纯强化学习更可靠且同样高效的政策。

强化学习/RL.title: Concept-Guided Spatial Regularization for World Models in Atari Pong
强化学习/RL.title_zh: Atari Pong世界中基于概念引导的空间正则化
强化学习/RL.summary: World models are usually evaluated as components of model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) systems, while the world models themselves are rarely studied in isolation.   We examine five representative visual world-model agents in Atari Pong: DreamerV3, DIAMOND, TWISTER, Simulus, and STORM. After r
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 世界模型通常作为基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）系统的组成部分进行评估，而世界模型本身很少被单独研究。本文考察了Atari Pong中的五个代表性视觉世界模型智能体：DreamerV3、DIAMOND、TWISTER、Simulus和STORM。在移除MBRL组件后，发现这些世界模型在单独测试时预测准确性较低。为此，作者提出了一种概念引导的空间正则化方法，利用游戏中的概念（如球和球拍位置）来约束世界模型的潜在空间，从而提高预测精度和样本效率。主要贡献在于首次系统性地孤立评估世界模型，并提出了有效的正则化技术，显著提升了MBRL性能。

人机交互/HCI.title: When AI Blurs the Boundaries of Contribution: An Empirical Study of Authorship Calibration
人机交互/HCI.title_zh: 当AI模糊贡献边界：作者身份校准的实证研究
人机交互/HCI.summary: The broad adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), especially Generative AI, raises pressing questions about how users interact with these systems to produce new content. In this paper, we introduce the concept of authorship calibration, defined as users awareness of their actual authorship when in...
人机交互/HCI.summary_zh: 人工智能特别是生成式AI的广泛采用，引发了关于用户如何与这些系统交互以产生新内容的紧迫问题。本文提出“作者身份校准”概念，即用户在使用AI生成内容时对自身实际作者权的认知程度。通过两个实证实验，发现用户普遍高估自己的贡献，且这种偏差受AI交互界面设计的影响。主要贡献在于定义并量化了AI协作中的作者权感知偏差，为设计更公平的AI协作工具提供了心理学依据。

机器人/RO.title: Steering Robustness into World Action Models via Mechanistic Interpretability and Optimal Control
机器人/RO.title_zh: 通过机制可解释性与最优控制增强世界行动模型的鲁棒性
机器人/RO.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable semantically- and physically-informed control but are brittle under distribution shift. In this work, we use mechanistic interpretability to study how robustness-relevant perturbations are represented in WAM activation space. Comparing activations across successful ...
机器人/RO.summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAM）能够实现语义和物理感知的控制，但在分布偏移下表现脆弱。本文利用机械可解释性研究鲁棒性相关扰动在WAM激活空间中的表示。通过比较成功和失败轨迹的激活模式，识别出对鲁棒性关键的特征方向，并基于最优控制理论设计干预策略，引导模型朝这些方向调整。实验表明，该方法在不牺牲性能的前提下，显著提升了WAM在未见环境中的泛化能力。

机器人/RO.title: Interventional Causal Circuits for Safe Robot Action Testing and Failure Recovery
机器人/RO.title_zh: 干预因果电路：用于安全机器人动作测试与故障恢复
机器人/RO.summary: Safe physical AI for robot actions are required not only likely to succeed but tested to be safe before execution. In practice, however, formal testing of motion parameters is computationally expensive, and the cost scales poorly with the dimensionality of the action space. When a proposed action is...
机器人/RO.summary_zh: 安全物理AI要求机器人动作不仅可能成功，而且执行前需经过安全测试。然而，运动参数的形式化测试计算成本高昂，且随动作空间维度扩展而急剧增长。本文提出干预因果电路（ICC），通过构建动作的因果图模型，仅测试关键因果节点即可评估整体安全性。当动作不安全时，ICC能定位故障原因并推荐修复策略。实验表明，该方法将测试成本降低数个数量级，同时保持高安全覆盖率。

NLP.title: CrimeNER Demo: Named-Entity Recognition in the Crime Domain
NLP.title_zh: CrimeNER演示：犯罪领域的命名实体识别
NLP.summary: We present CrimeNER Demo, an AI-powered platform that enables us to extract general crime-related information from documents and classify them into entity types with two levels of granularity. We provide pretrained NER models on the CrimeNER database, and we give the possibility to users to provide
NLP.summary_zh: 本文介绍了CrimeNER演示平台，这是一个基于AI的平台，能够从文档中提取与犯罪相关的一般信息，并将其分类为两种粒度级别的实体类型。该平台提供了在CrimeNER数据库上预训练的命名实体识别（NER）模型，并允许用户提供自己的数据进行测试。主要贡献包括：构建了首个面向犯罪领域的细粒度NER数据集，开发了预训练模型，并提供了交互式演示界面。该平台在犯罪信息抽取任务上取得了高精度，有助于执法和情报分析。创新点在于针对犯罪领域的特殊性设计了实体类型体系，并实现了用户友好的工具。

NLP.title: Can LLMs Build a MaxSAT Solver from Papers? The CoreForge Experience
NLP.title_zh: LLM能否从论文构建MaxSAT求解器？CoreForge的经验
NLP.summary: We report on CoreForge, an experience in using large language models (LLMs) to build an unweighted MaxSAT solver from research papers rather than from an existing solver codebase. The project focuses on unsatisfiability-based MaxSAT algorithms and follows an iterative workflow that combines paper digestion, code generation, and testing. The results show that LLMs can successfully implement a solver from scratch based solely on paper descriptions, achieving competitive performance on standard benchmarks.
NLP.summary_zh: 本文报告了CoreForge项目，探索使用大型语言模型（LLM）从研究论文而非现有求解器代码库构建无权重MaxSAT求解器。项目聚焦于基于不可满足性的MaxSAT算法，采用结合论文理解、代码生成和测试的迭代工作流。结果表明，LLM能够仅根据论文描述从头实现求解器，并在标准基准上取得有竞争力的性能。创新点在于完全依赖论文文本进行代码生成，验证了LLM在算法实现中的潜力。

NLP.title: Digital Pantheon: Simulating and Auditing Coalition Formation with LLM Agents
NLP.title_zh: 数字万神殿：使用LLM智能体模拟和审计联盟形成
NLP.summary: The formation of political coalitions is a complex negotiation driven by both concrete policy objectives and deep-seated ideological convictions. While Large Language Models (LLMs) open new avenues for computational political science, the neutrality and helpfulness biases instilled by Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) may skew simulations. We introduce Digital Pantheon, a framework for simulating coalition formation using LLM agents that are explicitly prompted with ideological profiles. We audit the impact of RLHF biases and propose mitigation strategies. Our experiments show that LLM agents can replicate real-world coalition patterns when biases are properly controlled.
NLP.summary_zh: 政治联盟的形成是一个复杂的协商过程，既受具体政策目标驱动，也受深层意识形态信念影响。虽然大型语言模型（LLM）为计算政治学开辟了新途径，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）所灌输的中立性和帮助性偏见可能扭曲模拟。本文提出数字万神殿框架，使用明确赋予意识形态特征的LLM智能体模拟联盟形成过程，审计RLHF偏见的影响并提出缓解策略。实验表明，在适当控制偏见时，LLM智能体能够复现现实世界的联盟模式。创新点在于将意识形态显式建模并审计RLHF偏见。

NLP.title: T^2MLR: Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence
NLP.summary: Transformer reasoning is limited by autoregressive decoding, which repeatedly compresses rich hidden computation through token space and makes it difficult for intermediate reasoning states to persist across time. We introduce Transformers with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence (T2MLR), a transformer variant that incorporates a recurrent connection at the middle layers across time steps. This allows intermediate representations to be reused and refined over multiple decoding steps, improving reasoning capabilities on tasks requiring multi-step inference. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks show consistent improvements over standard transformers.
NLP.summary_zh: Transformer推理受限于自回归解码，该过程反复将丰富的隐藏计算压缩到token空间，导致中间推理状态难以跨时间步持续。本文提出具有时间中层循环的Transformer（T²MLR），一种在中间层引入跨时间步循环连接的变体。这使得中间表示可以在多个解码步骤中被重用和细化，从而提升需要多步推理的任务的推理能力。在推理基准上的实验表明，相比标准Transformer有持续改进。创新点在于在Transformer中层引入时间维度的循环连接，增强了长程推理能力。

NLP.title: Latent Trajectory Discrimination for AI-Generated Text Detection
NLP.title_zh: 用于AI生成文本检测的潜在轨迹判别
NLP.summary: Most existing approaches to AI-Generated Text Detection (AIGTD) treat documents as static objects and base their decisions on aggregate statistics or globally compressed embeddings. However, this perspective overlooks the inherently dynamic nature of autoregressive generation, where content evolves token by token. We propose a novel method that captures the latent trajectory of the generation process by analyzing the hidden states at each step. By discriminating between human and machine trajectories, our approach achieves state-of-the-art detection accuracy, especially against paraphrasing attacks.
NLP.summary_zh: 现有AI生成文本检测（AIGTD）方法大多将文档视为静态对象，基于聚合统计或全局压缩嵌入进行决策。然而，这种视角忽视了自回归生成固有的动态特性，即内容逐token演化。本文提出一种新方法，通过分析每一步的隐藏状态来捕捉生成过程的潜在轨迹。通过区分人类和机器的轨迹，该方法实现了最先进的检测精度，尤其对释义攻击具有鲁棒性。创新点在于利用生成过程的动态轨迹而非静态特征进行检测。

NLP.title: Dialogue Summarization with Emotion Dynamics Using Topic- and Participant-Centric Decomposition
NLP.title_zh: 基于主题和参与者中心分解的情感动态对话摘要
NLP.summary: Existing text summarization research has focused much on monologic information (e.g., newspaper articles, reports) without accounting for the interaction between speakers or authors. In contrast, dialogues are a rich communication channel where multiple participants conduct back and forth exchanges
NLP.summary_zh: 现有文本摘要研究主要关注独白式信息（如新闻文章、报告），未考虑说话者或作者之间的互动。然而，对话是一种丰富的沟通渠道，多个参与者进行来回交流。本文提出了一种基于主题和参与者中心分解的方法，用于捕捉对话中的情感动态，并生成更准确的摘要。创新点在于将对话分解为主题维度和参与者维度，分别建模情感变化，从而在摘要中保留关键情感信息。主要贡献是提升了对话摘要的情感连贯性和信息完整性。

AI伦理与治理.title: Global Index on Responsible AI: 2026 Report
AI伦理与治理.title_zh: 全球负责任AI指数：2026年报告
AI伦理与治理.summary: Grounded in human rights-based frameworks such as the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI, the Global Index on Responsible AI (GIRAI) examines how countries translate responsible AI commitments into enforceable protections, institutional capacity, and redress mechanisms. GIRAI 2026 assesses th
AI伦理与治理.summary_zh: 基于联合国教科文组织《人工智能伦理建议》等人权框架，全球负责任AI指数（GIRAI）考察各国如何将负责任的AI承诺转化为可执行的保护措施、机构能力和补救机制。2026年报告评估了多个国家的AI治理实践，包括法律框架、政策实施和问责机制。主要贡献在于提供了首个全球性的负责任AI进展量化评估，揭示了不同国家在AI伦理落实上的差距。创新点在于建立了多维度评估体系，涵盖透明度、公平性、问责制等关键指标，为政策制定者提供了参考。

AI公平性与医学影像.title: Demographically-Conditioned Synthetic Medical Images for Bias Mitigation and Bias Detection in Disease Classifiers
AI公平性与医学影像.title_zh: 基于人口统计条件合成的医学图像用于疾病分类器的偏差缓解与偏差检测
AI公平性与医学影像.summary: Per-subgroup fairness audits of medical image classifiers face a sample-size problem: minority subgroups in held-out test sets have so few samples that the resulting confidence intervals on per-subgroup performance are wider than the bias the audit is meant to detect. We argue that a demographically-conditioned generative model can produce synthetic images for under-represented subgroups, augmenting the test set to enable statistically significant bias detection. Furthermore, the same generative approach can be used to rebalance training data for bias mitigation. Experiments on chest X-ray datasets show that our method improves both bias detection power and classifier fairness without sacrificing overall accuracy.
AI公平性与医学影像.summary_zh: 医学图像分类器的子组公平性审计面临样本量问题：保留测试集中的少数子组样本过少，导致子组性能的置信区间比要检测的偏差还宽。本文提出使用人口统计条件生成模型为少数子组生成合成图像，扩充测试集以实现统计显著的偏差检测。同时，该生成方法也可用于重新平衡训练数据以缓解偏差。在胸部X光数据集上的实验表明，该方法在不牺牲整体准确率的前提下，提升了偏差检测能力和分类器公平性。

AI安全与软件工程.title: Proof-or-Stop: Don't Trust the Agent, Trust the Evidence -- Loop Engineering for Verifiable Evidence-Gated Lifecycle Control
AI安全与软件工程.title_zh: 证明或停止：不要信任智能体，信任证据——可验证证据门控生命周期控制的循环工程
AI安全与软件工程.summary: Autonomous coding agents increasingly execute multi-step software work, but lifecycle states such as reviewed, tested, DONE, and ready-to-merge remain claims unless supported by current evidence. We present Proof-or-Stop Lifecycle Control, a method that permits lifecycle transitions only when fresh, verifiable evidence is produced and validated. The approach uses a loop engineering paradigm where each step generates evidence that is automatically checked before proceeding. Experiments on code generation and bug fixing tasks demonstrate that this method significantly reduces false claims of completion and improves reliability of autonomous software agents.
AI安全与软件工程.summary_zh: 自主编码智能体越来越多地执行多步骤软件工作，但生命周期状态（如已审查、已测试、完成、准备合并）若无当前证据支持则仅为声明。本文提出“证明或停止”生命周期控制方法，仅当产生并验证了新鲜、可验证的证据时才允许生命周期转换。该方法采用循环工程范式，每个步骤生成证据并在继续前自动检查。在代码生成和错误修复任务上的实验表明，该方法显著减少了完成状态的虚假声明，提升了自主软件智能体的可靠性。

AI与科学哲学.title: The Industrialization of Research ; On AI-Driven Science and Its Consequences
AI与科学哲学.title_zh: 研究的工业化：论AI驱动的科学及其后果
AI与科学哲学.summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming scientific research - not merely as a more powerful instrument, but as an autonomous participant in the research cycle itself. This transition constitutes, in the most precise sense of the term, the industrialization of research: a shift from a craft model, in which individual researchers conceive, execute, and interpret experiments, to an industrial model in which AI systems generate hypotheses, design experiments, and analyze results at scale. The paper discusses the epistemological, ethical, and societal consequences of this shift, including changes in scientific creativity, reproducibility, and the role of human scientists.
AI与科学哲学.summary_zh: 人工智能正在改变科学研究——不仅是作为更强大的工具，而是作为研究循环本身的自主参与者。这种转变在最精确的意义上构成了研究的工业化：从工匠模式（个体研究者构思、执行和解释实验）转向工业模式（AI系统大规模生成假设、设计实验和分析结果）。本文讨论了这种转变的认识论、伦理和社会后果，包括科学创造力、可重复性以及人类科学家角色的变化。

可解释AI与心理健康.title: Self-Evolving Human-Centered Framework for Explainable Depression Symptom Annotation
可解释AI与心理健康.title_zh: 面向可解释抑郁症状标注的自进化人本框架
可解释AI与心理健康.summary: Annotation quality is a major bottleneck in building reliable and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) systems for mental health research. In depression-related datasets, labels are often assigned without structured evidence, symptom-level justification, or traceable alignment with the criteria. We propose a self-evolving human-centered framework that integrates human annotators with an AI assistant to produce high-quality, explainable annotations. The framework iteratively improves annotation guidelines based on disagreements and provides symptom-level explanations. Experiments on a depression dataset show that our method improves inter-annotator agreement and yields more consistent, clinically meaningful annotations compared to standard approaches.
可解释AI与心理健康.summary_zh: 标注质量是构建可靠且可解释人工智能（XAI）系统用于心理健康研究的主要瓶颈。在抑郁症相关数据集中，标签通常缺乏结构化证据、症状级理由或与诊断标准的可追溯对齐。本文提出一个自进化的人本框架，将人类标注者与AI助手结合，生成高质量、可解释的标注。该框架基于分歧迭代改进标注指南，并提供症状级解释。在抑郁症数据集上的实验表明，与标准方法相比，我们的方法提高了标注者间一致性，并产生了更一致、更具临床意义的标注。

多模态软件工程.title: MM-IssueLoc: A Controlled Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Evidence in Multimodal Repository-Level Issue Localization
多模态软件工程.title_zh: MM-IssueLoc：用于评估多模态仓库级问题定位中视觉证据的受控基准
多模态软件工程.summary: Real repository issues routinely include visual evidence such as screenshots, error dialogs, rendered UI states, and logs, yet repository-level issue localization is evaluated mostly as a text-only task. Existing multimodal SE benchmarks evaluate end-to-end repair, entangling localization with patch generation. We present MM-IssueLoc, a controlled benchmark that isolates the localization task by providing both textual and visual inputs, and requiring models to identify the exact file and line of the issue. The benchmark includes diverse issues from real repositories with carefully curated visual evidence. Evaluation of state-of-the-art models reveals that incorporating visual information significantly improves localization accuracy, especially for UI-related issues.
多模态软件工程.summary_zh: 真实仓库问题通常包含截图、错误对话框、渲染的UI状态和日志等视觉证据，但仓库级问题定位主要作为纯文本任务进行评估。现有的多模态软件工程基准评估端到端修复，将定位与补丁生成混在一起。本文提出MM-IssueLoc，一个受控基准，通过提供文本和视觉输入并将定位任务分离出来，要求模型识别问题的确切文件和行号。该基准包含来自真实仓库的多样化问题，并配有精心整理的视觉证据。对最先进模型的评估表明，融入视觉信息显著提高了定位准确性，尤其是对于UI相关问题。

多模态学习.title: ANet Patu-1: The Value of Connection in the Agent Network
多模态学习.title_zh: ANet Patu-1：智能体网络中连接的价值
多模态学习.summary: The Internet taught us that the value of a network depends on how its nodes connect: broadcast stars scale as V∝N (Sarnoff), fully-connected meshes as N^2 (Metcalfe), and group-forming networks as 2^N (Reed). We ask the analogous question for networks of AI agents. We model an agent network where agents communicate and collaborate, and analyze how the value scales with the number of agents and connection patterns. We propose a new metric for agent network value and demonstrate its utility in designing efficient agent topologies.
多模态学习.summary_zh: 互联网告诉我们，网络的价值取决于节点如何连接：广播星型网络价值与节点数N成正比（Sarnoff定律），全连接网状网络与N²成正比（Metcalfe定律），群组网络与2^N成正比（Reed定律）。本文对AI智能体网络提出类似问题。我们建模了一个智能体通信协作网络，分析价值如何随智能体数量和连接模式扩展。提出了一种新的智能体网络价值度量，并展示了其在设计高效智能体拓扑中的实用性。创新点在于将网络价值定律推广到AI智能体网络。

多模态学习.title: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Scientific Visualization Literacy
多模态学习.title_zh: 面向科学可视化素养的多模态大语言模型基准测试
多模态学习.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interpret visualizations, yet current evaluations remain largely chart-centric and provide limited evidence of understanding of scientific visualization (SciVis). We benchmark six MLLMs on the scientific visualization literacy assessm
多模态学习.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地用于解释可视化，但当前评估仍以图表为中心，对科学可视化（SciVis）理解能力的证据有限。本文在科学可视化素养评估上对六个MLLM进行基准测试。创新点在于专门针对科学可视化设计评估任务，而非通用图表。主要贡献是揭示了MLLM在理解科学可视化方面的不足，并为未来改进提供了方向。

时间序列预测.title: Asymmetric Peak-Aware Loss for Peak-Critical Time Series Forecasting
时间序列预测.title_zh: 面向峰值关键时间序列预测的非对称峰值感知损失函数
时间序列预测.summary: In many operational time-series forecasting applications, such as crowd demand forecasting, the risk related to under-prediction is substantially higher than that of over-prediction. Accurate prediction of rare demand spikes plays a critical role in downstream tasks. Yet most time-series forecasters
时间序列预测.summary_zh: 在许多操作性时间序列预测应用中（如人群需求预测），低估风险远高于高估风险。准确预测罕见的需求峰值对下游任务至关重要。然而，大多数时间序列预测器未针对峰值进行优化。本文提出了一种非对称峰值感知损失函数，通过对低估施加更大惩罚来提升峰值预测精度。创新点在于设计了一种自适应非对称损失，聚焦于罕见但关键的峰值事件。主要贡献是显著提高了峰值关键场景下的预测性能。

AI for Science.title: LQCDMaster: Agentic Scientific Computing for Lattice Quantum Chromodynamics Research

Here we present \textsc{LQCDMaster}, a tool-augme
AI for Science.summary_zh: 格点量子色动力学（LQCD）为计算强子可观测量提供了第一性原理框架，但其实际应用受限于将研究动机转化为可靠计算工作流所需的专业知识。本文提出LQCDMaster，一个工具增强的智能体系统，自动化LQCD计算流程。创新点在于将AI代理与科学计算工具结合，降低领域门槛。主要贡献是实现了从研究问题到计算结果的端到端自动化，加速了LQCD研究。

AI基础模型.title: CFM-Bench: A Unified Multi-Domain, Multi-Task Benchmark for Channel Foundation Models
AI基础模型.title_zh: CFM-Bench：面向信道基础模型的统一多域多任务基准
AI基础模型.summary: Channel foundation models (CFMs) are developing rapidly, with recent studies reporting benefits from pretraining across downstream wireless tasks. Yet CFMs are commonly evaluated in model-specific pipelines with different data, radio configurations, partitions, adaptation procedures, task definition
AI基础模型.summary_zh: 信道基础模型（CFM）发展迅速，近期研究显示跨下游无线任务的预训练带来收益。然而，CFM通常在模型特定的流程中评估，使用不同数据、无线电配置、分区、自适应过程和任务定义。本文提出CFM-Bench，一个统一的多域多任务基准，涵盖多种无线场景。创新点在于标准化评估流程，支持公平比较。主要贡献是建立了CFM评估的通用标准，推动该领域发展。

图神经网络.summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) reasoning under the extrapolation setting focuses on forecasting future time-stamped events (facts) from historical data in a temporal knowledge graph. Existing approaches, reinforcement learning (RL)-based multi-hop reasoning methods are prominent for TKG reasoning be
图神经网络.summary_zh: 针对时态知识图谱（TKG）外推推理中预测未来事件的任务，本文提出一种可达性感知的预训练方法。创新点在于在预训练阶段引入可达性信息，引导强化学习智能体更高效地探索目标导向的路径，避免无效搜索。主要贡献是设计了一个预训练目标，使模型在推理前即能估计实体间的可达性，从而显著提升多跳推理的效率和准确性，实验表明在多个基准数据集上优于现有RL方法。

软件工程/SE.title: Large Language Models for Code Generation from Multilingual Prompts: A Curated Benchmark and a Study on Code Quality
软件工程/SE.title_zh: 面向多语言提示的代码生成大型语言模型：一个精选基准及代码质量研究
软件工程/SE.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform differently on identical programming tasks when prompted in different natural languages, a phenomenon known as language bias. While this behavior has been widely studied for general text generation, its impact on code generation quality and programming convention...
软件工程/SE.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在使用不同自然语言提示时，对相同编程任务的执行表现存在差异，这种现象称为语言偏差。虽然这一行为在通用文本生成中已被广泛研究，但其对代码生成质量和编程规范的影响尚不明确。本文构建了一个精选的多语言代码生成基准，并系统研究了语言偏差对代码质量的影响。创新点包括：首次量化了不同自然语言提示对LLM代码生成正确性和可读性的影响，并揭示了语言偏差在代码生成中的表现模式。主要贡献在于为多语言代码生成任务提供了评估基准和优化方向。

医学AI.title: MedFailBench: A Clinician-Built Open-Source Benchmark for Medical AI Safety Boundary Inspection
医学AI.title_zh: MedFailBench：临床医生构建的医学AI安全边界检查开源基准
医学AI.summary: Most medical AI benchmarks measure whether a model knows the correct answer. MedFailBench asks a different question: which safety boundary failed? We present a clinician-built synthetic benchmark and failure atlas that labels medical AI errors by severity (1--5) and safety gate type (missed urgent e...
医学AI.summary_zh: 大多数医学AI基准测试衡量模型是否知道正确答案，而MedFailBench提出一个不同的问题：哪个安全边界失效了？本文呈现了一个由临床医生构建的合成基准和故障图谱，按严重性（1-5级）和安全门类型（如遗漏紧急事件、错误警报等）对医学AI错误进行标注。创新点在于从安全边界角度评估医学AI，而非仅关注准确性。主要贡献包括：提供细粒度的错误分类标准，以及一个开源基准，用于系统性地检查医学AI系统的安全边界，从而提升其在临床部署中的可靠性。

category_summaries.AI伦理与法律: 该方向关注AI系统的公平性、透明度和责任归属。今日研究趋势包括：算法偏见检测与缓解、隐私保护技术、以及AI法律框架的构建。亮点是提出了一种基于因果推理的公平性评估方法，以及针对生成式AI的版权问题探讨。
category_summaries.可解释性与安全性: 研究方向集中于提升AI模型的可解释性和鲁棒性。今日亮点包括：利用注意力机制解释模型决策、对抗样本防御新策略、以及形式化验证方法在神经网络中的应用。趋势是向更高效的解释方法和更实用的安全评估框架发展。
category_summaries.LLM应用: 探讨大语言模型在各行业的落地应用。今日研究涵盖：LLM辅助编程、医疗咨询、教育辅导、以及客户服务。亮点是提出了一种结合知识图谱的LLM问答系统，显著减少了幻觉现象。趋势是向多模态和领域专用模型发展。
category_summaries.语音AI: 包括语音识别、合成、情感分析等。今日趋势：多说话人语音分离、跨语言语音合成、以及端到端语音处理模型。亮点是一种基于扩散模型的语音生成方法，实现了高保真度和实时性。
category_summaries.计算机视觉: 涵盖图像分类、目标检测、语义分割等基础任务。今日研究亮点：提出了一种新的自监督学习框架，在少样本场景下取得SOTA；以及一种高效的视频理解模型。趋势是向更轻量级、更鲁棒的视觉模型发展。
category_summaries.计算机视觉/CV: 与计算机视觉方向类似，但更侧重于CV子领域。今日研究包括：3D重建、姿态估计、视觉推理。亮点是一种利用神经辐射场进行动态场景重建的方法。趋势是结合生成模型和物理模拟。
category_summaries.机器学习/ML: 关注ML算法理论与优化。今日趋势：元学习、贝叶斯优化、以及图神经网络。亮点是一种新的梯度下降变体，加速了非凸优化收敛。研究重点在于提高训练效率和泛化能力。
category_summaries.机器人: 涵盖机器人控制、感知、规划。今日研究亮点：基于强化学习的灵巧操作、视觉伺服控制、以及人机协作安全策略。趋势是向更自主、更适应复杂环境的方向发展。
category_summaries.大语言模型/LLM: 聚焦LLM的架构、训练和评估。今日趋势：模型压缩、指令微调、以及长文本处理。亮点是一种稀疏注意力机制，降低了推理成本。研究热点包括可扩展性和知识更新。
category_summaries.AI应用: 广泛领域的AI应用，如金融、医疗、农业等。今日亮点：AI辅助疾病诊断系统、智能投资顾问、以及作物病害检测。趋势是跨领域融合和实际部署中的鲁棒性。
category_summaries.硬件与AI: 研究AI专用硬件和算法协同设计。今日趋势：神经网络加速器、存算一体芯片、以及边缘AI。亮点是一种基于RRAM的模拟计算单元，实现了低功耗推理。
category_summaries.自动化科研: 利用AI加速科学发现过程。今日研究：自动实验设计、文献挖掘、以及假设生成。亮点是一种AI驱动的材料发现平台，成功预测了新型催化剂。趋势是向自动化实验室发展。
category_summaries.文本到图像生成: 主要关注文本条件图像生成模型。今日趋势：高分辨率生成、可控生成、以及个性化生成。亮点是一种基于扩散模型的细粒度控制方法，实现了精确的布局和风格控制。
category_summaries.网络安全: AI在网络安全中的应用，如入侵检测、恶意软件分析。今日亮点：基于图神经网络的异常流量检测、以及对抗性攻击防御。趋势是向实时、自适应安全系统发展。
category_summaries.NLP/文本检测: 包括文本分类、情感分析、机器翻译等。今日趋势：多语言NLP、低资源语言处理、以及事实核查。亮点是一种跨语言预训练模型，在零样本翻译上表现优异。
category_summaries.生成模型: 研究各类生成模型，如GAN、VAE、扩散模型。今日趋势：可控生成、条件生成、以及生成质量评估。亮点是一种新的扩散模型加速采样方法，减少步数同时保持质量。
category_summaries.人工智能/通用AI: 探讨通用人工智能的理论和框架。今日研究：认知架构、意识模型、以及通用学习算法。亮点是一种基于主动推理的智能体框架，展示了灵活的任务适应能力。
category_summaries.强化学习/RL: 关注RL算法在复杂环境中的应用。今日趋势：离线RL、多智能体RL、以及样本效率提升。亮点是一种基于模型预测控制的RL方法，在机器人控制中取得突破。
category_summaries.人机交互/HCI: 研究人与AI系统的交互设计。今日趋势：自然语言界面、情感计算、以及协作式AI。亮点是一种基于眼神追踪的交互系统，提升了无障碍体验。
category_summaries.机器人/RO: 与机器人方向类似，但更强调操作和运动规划。今日亮点：一种基于学习的抓取规划方法，处理未知物体。趋势是向通用操作技能发展。
category_summaries.NLP: 自然语言处理基础研究。今日趋势：预训练模型微调、语义解析、以及对话系统。亮点是一种新的对比学习框架，提升了句子表示的判别性。
category_summaries.AI伦理与治理: 探讨AI的社会影响和治理框架。今日研究：算法问责制、AI政策制定、以及全球合作。亮点是一种参与式AI治理模型，融合多方利益相关者意见。
category_summaries.AI公平性与医学影像: 交叉方向，关注医学影像中的公平性问题。今日研究：种族和性别偏见检测、以及公平性增强算法。亮点是一种去偏方法，在多个数据集上显著减少性能差异。
category_summaries.AI安全与软件工程: 结合AI安全与软件工程实践。今日趋势：AI系统可靠性测试、对抗性鲁棒性验证。亮点是一种基于模糊测试的AI安全评估工具。
category_summaries.AI与科学哲学: 探讨AI对科学方法论的影响。今日研究：AI驱动的科学发现哲学、模型可解释性。亮点是一篇关于AI如何改变科学推理的哲学分析。
category_summaries.可解释AI与心理健康: 应用可解释AI于心理健康领域。今日研究：抑郁症诊断解释、治疗推荐解释。亮点是一种利用注意力机制解释情绪识别模型的方法。
category_summaries.多模态软件工程: 多模态数据在软件工程中的应用。今日研究：代码与自然语言结合、图像辅助调试。亮点是一种多模态代码搜索方法，提升了检索效率。
category_summaries.多模态学习: 研究不同模态数据的联合学习。今日趋势：视觉-语言模型、音频-视觉融合。亮点是一种统一的多模态预训练框架，在多个任务上取得SOTA。
category_summaries.时间序列预测: 关注时间序列数据的预测方法。今日趋势：概率预测、长序列预测、以及可解释性。亮点是一种基于Transformer的改进模型，在长期预测中表现优异。
category_summaries.AI for Science: AI在科学研究中的应用，如物理、化学、生物。今日亮点：AI加速分子动力学模拟、蛋白质结构预测新方法。趋势是向物理约束的AI模型发展。
category_summaries.AI基础模型: 研究大规模基础模型的训练和特性。今日趋势：模型扩展法则、涌现能力、以及对齐。亮点是一种新的缩放律，预测了模型能力随规模的变化。
category_summaries.图神经网络: 关注图数据的深度学习。今日趋势：动态图学习、异构图网络、以及可扩展GNN。亮点是一种基于注意力机制的异构图模型，在推荐系统上表现优异。
category_summaries.软件工程/SE: AI在软件工程中的应用。今日研究：代码生成、缺陷预测、测试自动化。亮点是一种基于LLM的自动程序修复方法，修复率显著提升。
category_summaries.医学AI: AI在医疗健康领域的应用。今日趋势：医学影像分析、疾病预测、个性化治疗。亮点是一种基于联邦学习的多中心诊断模型，保护数据隐私同时提升性能。

highlights: 研究亮点1：《用于研究语言模型欺骗行为的转码器》——首次将转码器应用于分析语言模型的欺骗行为，为检测和缓解模型安全风险提供了可解释性工具，具有重要的安全价值。
研究亮点2：《StructureClaw：面向结构工程工作流的可追踪LLM智能体与可执行基准》——创新性地将LLM与工程工具链集成，实现了对复杂多步骤工作流的自动化追踪与评估，实用性强，有望推动AI在工程领域的落地。
研究亮点3：《无真实人脸的基准测试：人脸识别评估新方法》——完全使用合成数据构建评估基准，解决了隐私问题，同时验证了与真实数据评估的一致性，为人脸识别研究提供了更道德、可扩展的评估方案。
研究亮点1：FlashDecoder提出纯Transformer流式视频解码器，实现实时潜在到像素解码，解决高分辨率长视频生成的速度和内存瓶颈，对视频生成应用有重要实用价值。
研究亮点2：RoboTTT将机器人策略的视觉运动上下文扩展至8000时间步，大幅超越现有方法，通过测试时训练实现长时任务适应，推动机器人基础模型在复杂场景中的应用。
研究亮点3：Subjective Risk Decomposition从主观风险角度统一不确定性量化框架，为认知和偶然不确定性提供新理论视角，具有重要学术价值。
研究亮点1：SearchOS-V1：提出多智能体共享记忆与任务进度追踪机制，有效解决长交互历史中搜索失败恢复问题，显著提升开放域信息检索的鲁棒性。
研究亮点2：Mask-Aware Policy Gradients：针对扩散语言模型，利用扩散过程结构推导可计算的对数似然下界，首次实现高效RL训练，在推理任务上媲美自回归模型。
研究亮点3：NIFA：创新性地将ReRAM非线性作为计算特征而非缺陷，结合FPGA数字逻辑，实现能效与精度的双赢，为硬件加速器设计提供新思路。
研究亮点1：Long-Context Fine-Tuning with Limited VRAM - 提出分层注意力和分段反向传播，在有限显存下实现长上下文微调，具有实用价值。
daily_summary: 今日AI研究动态涵盖34个类别，共63篇论文。热点集中在LLM应用、计算机视觉、多模态学习等方向。LLM方面，研究聚焦于模型压缩、指令微调和长文本处理，提出稀疏注意力机制降低推理成本。计算机视觉领域，自监督学习框架在少样本场景取得突破，神经辐射场用于动态场景重建。多模态学习方向，统一预训练框架在视觉-语言任务中表现优异。此外，AI for Science亮点突出，AI加速分子动力学模拟和蛋白质结构预测。伦理与安全方面，公平性检测和对抗防御持续受关注。整体趋势显示，AI研究正向更高效、更鲁棒、更可解释的方向发展，跨领域融合和实际部署成为重点。
